# UpForex

> UpForex (UP Global Markets Ltd) is an online broker offering forex and CFD trading across forex, stocks, precious metals, indices, energy and cryptocurrencies on the MetaTrader 5 platform.

## Trading
- [Trading Accounts](https://www.upforex.com/accounts): Account types and trading conditions.
- [MetaTrader 5 (MT5) Platform](https://www.upforex.com/platforms/mt5): Platform overview and features.

## Products
- [Forex CFDs](https://www.upforex.com/products/forex-cfds): Trade major, minor and exotic currency pairs.
- [Stock CFDs](https://www.upforex.com/products/stock-cfds): Trade CFDs on global company shares.
- [Precious Metal](https://www.upforex.com/products/precious-metal): Trade gold, silver and other metals.
- [Index CFDs](https://www.upforex.com/products/index-cfds): Trade CFDs on global stock indices.
- [Energy CFDs](https://www.upforex.com/products/energy-cfds): Trade oil and other energy markets.
- [Cryptocurrencies CFD](https://www.upforex.com/products/cryptocurrencies-cfd): Trade crypto CFDs.
